crossRefs.note: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together…
lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your…
When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome…
But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,
who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,
One winking with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies…
They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
Moreover, my father, behold, yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe…
May Yahweh judge between me and you, and may Yahweh avenge me of you; but my hand will not be on you.
They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.
But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’

translations.web: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.
translations.bsb: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.
translations.kjv: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
translations.asv: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; Neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
